tldr: OS-Copilot is a framework for building generalist OS-level computer agents, featuring FRIDAY—a self-improving agent that learns to control unfamiliar applications through self-directed learning. FRIDAY achieves 40.86% success on GAIA level-1 tasks (35% relative improvement over prior best) and 6.12% on challenging level-3 tasks.
contributions: OS-Copilot: a unified interface framework for building generalist computer agents on Linux and MacOS
FRIDAY: a self-improving embodied agent with self-directed learning capability
Demonstration of autonomous tool acquisition for unfamiliar applications (Excel, React, PowerPoint)
Strong evaluation on GAIA benchmark surpassing prior systems including AutoGPT-4
methods: OS-Copilot provides a universal interface consolidating four control methods: Python code interpreter, bash terminal, mouse/keyboard control, and API calls. The framework comprises four components: a planner that decomposes tasks (supporting DAG-based parallel planning), a configurator with declarative memory (user profile, semantic knowledge) and procedural memory (tool repository), working memory, and an actor with execution and self-criticism stages. FRIDAY's self-directed learning module autonomously proposes task curricula, solves them through trial-and-error, and accumulates tools into its repository.
results: On GAIA benchmark, FRIDAY achieves 40.86% success on level-1 tasks (vs. 30.3% previous best, 14.4% for AutoGPT-4) and 6.12% on level-3 tasks (where no prior system succeeded). On SheetCopilot-20 spreadsheet dataset, FRIDAY without learning scores 0%, while with self-directed learning it achieves 60%, surpassing SheetCopilot (55% with GPT-4). FRIDAY autonomously generated 8 tools from 10 Excel tasks and learned PowerPoint manipulation tools through self-learning.
limitations: The User Profile module remains a conceptual design due to lack of corresponding benchmarks. The system was evaluated using GPT-4-turbo-1106 due to limited budget. The Critic module faces challenges in assessing task completion without ground truth. FRIDAY had only 4 basic seed tools initially and limited exploration on the development set.
